name: EZViewer
description: View a file's contents by type where it is recognised, and as hex where it is not.
about: EZViewer opens a file and renders it according to its extension: text and markup as text, spreadsheets and delimited files as a grid, PDFs and images as themselves. Anything it does not recognise is shown in a hex editor rather than refused, so the tool always displays something. Which extensions map to which viewer is read from a plain text file beside the executable and can be edited, so a format encountered often can be added without waiting for a release. It renders files and does not alter them, which is what makes it usable against material that must not change.
